description: Ask for a quote on supply store products for the signed-in member. ShearQuery's agent prices the order on the store's own site, usually in a few seconds, with the store's real shipping and tax for the address; if it can't, a person quotes it soon and it shows in my_supply_orders. NOTHING IS CHARGED OR ORDERED by this tool. Either from_cart: true to quote what's in their cart (my_supply_cart), or items: product_id from shop_supplies, qty, and option (the option's label exactly as shop_supplies listed it) for any product that has options. All items must be from one store. ship_to is a US address; ask the member for it (name, street, city, two-letter state, ZIP; phone optional) rather than guessing, and read it back before calling. After a quote, tell them the total line by line and ask whether to accept (decide_supply_quote), which pays from their wallet.

from_cart.description: Quote what's in the member's cart (my_supply_cart) instead of items. The quoted items leave the cart.

option.description: The option's label, e.g. '#1005', for a product with options.

note.description: Anything the member wants to add (optional).

name: request_supply_quote
title: Get a quote for a supply order
